protocol: New simple_studio_edit_v1 task, 960 TRAIN / 96 development VAL. Full frozen Qwen vision24+language28 first. Fresh reference RGB+short prompt cache; never reuse old complex scene hidden states. Continue trained spatial electronic parent, native instruction-only semantic readout and fixed RMS .15 text injection into existing spatial bridge, no extra network or input branch. Frozen VAE and Qwen; train original adapter/SpatialBridge/UNet cross-attention+LoRA/input injection, same one-step scheduler. Up to 60 epochs with 12-epoch patience, DEV LPIPS selects best; three tasks shown with short prompts. Coarse family labels intentionally span multiple targets: never exclude them as ambiguous. No heldout exposure or inference. Source/reference VAE latents are TRAIN auxiliary supervision only, never inference conditioning.
